title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Aggregate Still Available on a Cover
content:
For a tier of `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` that has an annual aggregate, the room left under that aggregate is measured cover by cover.

## Definition

The **aggregate still available** on a cover is the tier's annual aggregate limit less the total of the settlement approvals already booked on that same cover whose approval date falls fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the date of the approval now being made. The figure never drops below 0.00.

- Only approvals on the same cover count. Approvals booked on any other cover the same holder has under the tier leave this cover's aggregate untouched.
- The aggregate therefore belongs to the cover, not to the cover holder.

## Which earlier approvals count (hypothetical dates)

Suppose the approval now being made is dated 15 March 2027.

| Earlier approval on the same cover dated | Whole calendar months before 15 March 2027 | Counted? |
|---|---|---|
| 16 March 2026 | 11 | yes |
| 15 March 2026 | 12 | no |
| 2 September 2026 | 6 | yes |
| an approval on another cover of the same holder, 1 February 2027 | not relevant | no |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A cover's tier has an annual aggregate limit of 40000.00. Approvals of 22000.00 and 11500.00 were booked on the cover within the counted period, and one of 9000.00 falls outside it. The aggregate still available is 40000.00 less 33500.00, which is 6500.00. Had the counted approvals totalled 41000.00, the aggregate still available would be 0.00.
